stories.h: WWE star Bronson Reed dies at 38
stories.p: WWE has announced the death of wrestler Bronson Reed, real name Jermaine Haley, at the age of 38 from medical complications. He had been seriously injured at a WWE event in Saudi Arabia three weeks earlier.
body: WWE has announced the death of wrestler Bronson Reed, whose real name was Jermaine Haley, at the age of 38.
## The announcement

In a statement on its website on Friday, 27 November 2026, WWE said Reed had died earlier that day from medical complications, but did not give further details. The company described him as a larger-than-life figure, a devoted family man and a beloved colleague, and sent its condolences to his pregnant wife, Paige, and their daughter.
## Earlier injury

His death came about three weeks after he was seriously injured at WWE's Crown Jewel event in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, on 7 November. During a tag team title match, Nigerian-born wrestler Oba Femi threw him off the stage through a stack of tables. Reed reportedly suffered broken ribs and a lacerated kidney and spent more than a week in hospital in Saudi Arabia. WWE has not said whether his death was linked to the injury.
## His career

Born in Adelaide, Australia, Reed joined WWE in 2019. He won the NXT North American Championship and the 2024 André the Giant Memorial Battle Royal. Wrestlers and fans around the world have paid tribute.
more: WWE says he died of medical complications.
He was injured at Crown Jewel on 7 November.
He leaves a pregnant wife and a daughter.

stories.h: INEC holds nationwide mock accreditation in 17,656 polling units
stories.p: INEC is conducting a mock voter accreditation and result transmission exercise across 17,656 polling units in all 36 states and the FCT on Saturday. It is testing its upgraded BVAS machines and security arrangements.
body: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) is conducting a nationwide mock voter accreditation and result transmission exercise on Saturday, 28 November 2026.
## The exercise

The test is taking place at 17,656 polling units across the 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory. It is designed to test INEC's upgraded Bimodal Voter Accreditation System (BVAS), the result transmission process and election security arrangements under simulated election-day conditions. Sample ballot papers are being used.
## Why it matters

The exercise comes ahead of the presidential and National Assembly elections on 16 January 2027. INEC has faced criticism in past elections over delays in uploading results, and this week the commission named nine states as hotspots for campaign violence.
## Lagos adjusts
Lagos State cancelled its monthly environmental sanitation exercise, which had been scheduled for the same morning, so that residents could take part.
more: The test covers 17,656 polling units.
It checks BVAS and result transmission.
Lagos cancelled its sanitation exercise for it.

stories.h: VeryDarkMan says he will register his own Ratel party and fund it himself
stories.p: Activist VeryDarkMan has announced plans to register the Ratel Political Party before 2032, saying he will pay the registration costs from his business earnings. He said the movement will start with grassroots offices.
body: Social media activist Martins Vincent Otse, popularly known as VeryDarkMan (VDM), has announced plans to register his own political party, the Ratel Political Party, before 2032.
## Paying his own way

In a video, VDM said he would fund the project with his own earnings from his businesses, rather than relying on supporters. He said he had heard the registration fee was over ₦50 million and that he would raise it. INEC's party registration guidelines set a non-refundable administrative fee of ₦50 million, and payment does not guarantee approval.
## Grassroots first
VDM said the Ratel movement would begin by focusing on grassroots positions, such as local government chairmen and councillors, rather than seats in the National Assembly.
## Background
'Ratel' is the name VDM uses for his followers. This week he also urged opposition leaders Peter Obi, Atiku Abubakar and Seyi Makinde to unite under one party against President Tinubu.
more: VDM wants to register the party before 2032.
He says he will pay the ₦50m fee himself.
He plans to start with local government seats.

stories.h: Remi Tinubu says EFCC can investigate her empowerment funds
stories.p: First Lady Remi Tinubu has said she does not use government money for her empowerment programmes and invited the EFCC to investigate. She spoke at an APC women's rally in Warri.
body: First Lady Oluremi Tinubu has challenged the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) to investigate the funds she uses for her empowerment programmes, insisting she does not use government money.
## What she said

Speaking on Friday, 27 November 2026, at the South-South APC women's presidential campaign rally in Warri, Delta State, the First Lady said wealthy Nigerians willingly donate to her charitable work because they trust her not to misuse their money. She said she had been involved in charity for years, had served three terms as a senator, and did not need to beg anyone for money.
## Peace message
She also urged APC supporters not to fight anyone during the campaign, saying the party was confident of victory.
## Background
The rally took place in Delta State days after a deadly attack on an NDC campaign event in Ughelli North, and amid growing concern about political violence ahead of the 2027 elections.
more: She says she does not use government money.
She invited the EFCC to check her funds.
She told supporters not to fight anyone.

stories.h: Presidential election turnout has fallen from 69% to 27% since 2003
stories.p: Turnout in Nigeria's presidential elections has dropped from a Fourth Republic high of about 69% in 2003 to under 27% in 2023, according to figures compiled by a statistics platform. The decline has continued for five straight elections.
body: Voter turnout in Nigeria's presidential elections has fallen sharply over the past two decades, according to figures shared by a statistics platform this week.
## The numbers

Measured as total votes cast as a share of registered voters, turnout reached a Fourth Republic high of 69.08% in 2003. It then fell to 57.49% in 2007 and 53.68% in 2011, and continued to decline in each election after that, reaching just 26.71% in 2023. That is a drop of more than 42 percentage points in 20 years.
## Why it matters

The figures come as parties and INEC step up efforts to get Nigerians to collect their Permanent Voter Cards and vote in the 16 January 2027 elections. INEC is also running a nationwide mock accreditation exercise on Saturday to test its systems.
## Background
Concerns about insecurity, logistics and confidence in the electoral process have often been cited as reasons for low turnout. INEC this week named nine states as hotspots for campaign violence.
more: Turnout was 69.08% in 2003.
It fell to 26.71% in 2023.
The 2027 election holds on 16 January.

stories.h: Chelsea suffer third straight Premier League defeat with 3-2 loss at Forest
stories.p: Chelsea lost 3-2 to Nottingham Forest at the City Ground on Friday, their third Premier League defeat in a row. Emmanuel Emegha scored twice but could not prevent the loss.
body: Chelsea's poor run continued on Friday, 27 November 2026, as they lost 3-2 to Nottingham Forest at the City Ground, their third Premier League defeat in a row.
## The match

Igor Jesus gave Forest the lead inside five minutes, and the home side led at half-time. Early in the second half, Morgan Gibbs-White scored from the penalty spot after Wesley Fofana fouled Liam Delap. Emmanuel Emegha pulled a goal back for Chelsea, but Gibbs-White restored the two-goal lead soon after. Emegha scored again late on, but Chelsea ran out of time.
## Alonso's verdict
Manager Xabi Alonso said after the game that his side were struggling with confidence.
## Poor form

Chelsea have now lost four of their last five league games, with their only win in that run coming against Manchester United. Last weekend they were beaten 4-1 at home by Leeds, after which Cole Palmer and Joao Pedro were seen exchanging words on the touchline.
more: Forest beat Chelsea 3-2 at the City Ground.
Emegha scored twice for Chelsea.
It is Chelsea's third league defeat in a row.

stories.h: NAFDAC shuts Abuja's Zuba International Market over fake products worth ₦300m
stories.p: NAFDAC has shut Zuba International Market in Abuja after a joint operation with police and the DSS reportedly uncovered counterfeit and unwholesome goods worth more than ₦300 million. Over 160 shops were inspected.
body: The National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) has shut down Zuba International Market in the Federal Capital Territory, Abuja.
## The operation

The closure followed a joint enforcement operation with the Nigeria Police Force and the Department of State Services, which reportedly uncovered counterfeit and unwholesome products worth more than ₦300 million. The exercise covered more than 160 shops in the market.
## Why now
NAFDAC said the closure was part of a wider crackdown on substandard and fake goods ahead of the festive season.
more: Over 160 shops were inspected.
Fake goods worth over ₦300m were reportedly found.
The crackdown comes ahead of Christmas.

stories.h: RMRDC chief urges Peter Obi to drop presidential bid and back Tinubu
stories.p: The Director-General of the Raw Materials Research and Development Council, Nnanyelugo Ike-Muonso, has reportedly called on Peter Obi to abandon his 2027 bid and support President Tinubu. He defended the removal of petrol subsidy.
body: Professor Nnanyelugo Ike-Muonso, Director-General of the Raw Materials Research and Development Council (RMRDC), has reportedly called on Peter Obi, the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) presidential candidate, to abandon his 2027 ambition and support President Bola Tinubu's re-election.
## What he said

Speaking to journalists in Abuja on Friday, 27 November 2026, Ike-Muonso is said to have defended the removal of the petrol subsidy, and argued that another four years would allow the president to build on his economic policies.
## Background
Obi is due to attend an opposition summit in Abuja on Monday with Atiku Abubakar and Seyi Makinde, where a cooperation pact is expected to be signed.

No response from Obi or the NDC was included in the reports.

stories.h: Nicole Scherzinger and fiancé Thom Evans split after seven years
stories.p: Former Pussycat Dolls singer Nicole Scherzinger and former rugby player Thom Evans have ended their relationship. Evans said the decision was Scherzinger's and that he respects it.
body: Former Pussycat Dolls singer Nicole Scherzinger and her fiancé, former rugby player Thom Evans, have ended their relationship after seven years together.
## The announcement

Evans, 41, announced the split in a statement on his Instagram Stories on Friday, 27 November 2026. He said that after seven years of love and commitment it was an incredibly difficult time, that the decision was made by Scherzinger, 48, and that he respected it and wished her happiness.
Scherzinger had not publicly commented on the breakup at the time of the reports.
## How they met
The couple met in 2019 on The X Factor: Celebrity, where Scherzinger was a judge and Evans competed as part of a singing group. They later became engaged.

stories.h: OK Movement withdraws support from Obi and the NDC
stories.p: The OK Movement, named after Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso, has reportedly pulled its campaign support from the NDC. Its director-general said the group had been told Obi and the party had chosen to cut ties with it.
body: The OK Movement, a support group named after the initials of NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi and his running mate Rabiu Kwankwaso, has reportedly withdrawn its campaign and mobilisation support from the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC).
## The announcement

In a statement on Friday, 27 November 2026, the movement's national director-general, John Ughulu, said the group had been informed that Obi and the NDC had decided to cut ties with it. He directed the movement's ward, local government and state structures to stop all involvement in NDC activities immediately.
## What next
Ughulu said the group had begun discussions with other political parties and presidential aspirants.
## Background
The development comes days before Obi is due to attend an opposition summit in Abuja with Atiku Abubakar and Seyi Makinde.
## The other side
No response from Obi or the NDC was included in the reports.
## NDC responds

The NDC dismissed the withdrawal as a calculated distraction that would not slow its campaign. The director-general of its national campaign council said the move followed a decision already announced by Obi and the party, linked to a row over a parallel campaign structure.
more: The OK Movement says it has stopped working with the NDC.
It says Obi's camp cut ties with it.

stories.h: Davido and cousins turn heads at Governor Adeleke's second-term inauguration
stories.p: Osun Governor Ademola Adeleke was sworn in for a second term on Friday in Osogbo. His nephew Davido and other family members drew attention with a coordinated appearance at the ceremony.
body: Osun State Governor Ademola Adeleke was inaugurated for a second term on Friday, 27 November 2026, at the Osogbo Township Stadium.
## Family affair

Afrobeats star Davido, the governor's nephew, drew almost as much attention as the ceremony itself. He arrived with his brother Adewale Adeleke and cousins Shina Adeleke, known as Shina Rambo, and Adebayo Adeleke, known as B-Red. The four men wore matching white traditional outfits, and photos of them spread quickly online.
Davido's father, businessman Adedeji Adeleke, also drew attention for showing respect to the Ooni of Ife at the event.
## Background
Adeleke, a chieftain of the Accord Party, dissolved his executive council earlier this week ahead of the start of his second term.

stories.h: VeryDarkMan urges Obi, Atiku and Makinde to form one party to face Tinubu
stories.p: Activist VeryDarkMan has called on Peter Obi, Atiku Abubakar and Seyi Makinde to put their ambitions aside and unite under one party against President Tinubu. The three are due at an opposition summit on Monday.
body: Social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM) has urged opposition leaders Peter Obi, Atiku Abubakar and Seyi Makinde to unite under one political party ahead of the 2027 election.
## What he said

In a post on Instagram, VDM said the three should sit down together and form one party to defeat President Bola Tinubu. He argued that they need to set aside their personal ambitions, and that a united front would make the contest against the ruling party more competitive.
## Background

Obi of the NDC, Atiku of the ADC and Makinde of the APM are expected at an opposition summit in Abuja on Monday, 30 November, where parties are due to sign a cooperation pact. The organisers have said it will not be a formal merger, and Makinde's camp has denied reports that he plans to step down for Atiku.

stories.h: Bella Shmurda buys three brand-new cars in one day
stories.p: Singer Bella Shmurda has reportedly bought three brand-new vehicles at once, a Toyota Hilux, a Mercedes-Benz and a Jeep Wrangler. Reports put their combined value at over ₦500 million.
body: Afrobeats singer Bella Shmurda has got fans talking after reportedly buying three brand-new cars on the same day.
## The cars

A video that circulated on X on Friday, 27 November 2026, showed the three vehicles at a car dealership: a Toyota Hilux, a Mercedes-Benz and a Jeep Wrangler. A dealer linked to the sale said the cars were brand-new, with zero mileage and their protective packaging still in place at handover.
Reports online put the combined value of the three vehicles at more than ₦500 million.
## How fans reacted
The purchase drew a flood of reactions, with many fans congratulating the singer. It comes days after Davido bought a Brabus G-Wagon reportedly worth $2.1 million to mark his birthday.

stories.h: Farage pledges to scrap UK graduate visa used by many Nigerian students
stories.p: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage has said his party would abolish the UK's post-study Graduate visa if it wins power. The route lets international graduates stay for two years after their degree.
body: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage has pledged to abolish the UK's post-study Graduate visa route if his party wins power, a move that would affect many Nigerian students who hope to work in Britain after their degrees.
## What he said

In a post on X, Farage argued that the route makes it harder for young Britons to find jobs, because it allows international graduates to stay for two years without a job offer and compete for entry-level roles. He said the Conservatives created the route and Labour kept it, and that Reform would end it.
## About the visa
The Graduate visa, introduced in July 2021, lets international students who complete an eligible UK degree stay to work or look for work without employer sponsorship or minimum salary requirements.

stories.h: Adesua Etomi celebrates good news after secretly battling health problems this year
stories.p: Actress Adesua Etomi-Wellington has revealed she spent much of 2026 going through medical procedures away from the public eye. She shared a video of her family celebrating test results, and some reports say she has been declared cancer-free.
body: Nollywood actress Adesua Etomi-Wellington has opened up about one of the hardest periods of her life, revealing that she spent much of 2026 dealing with health challenges that she kept largely private.
## The announcement

In a video posted on Instagram on Friday, 27 November 2026, the actress, who is married to singer Banky W, was seen on a video call with a group of women, believed to be family members or close friends, as she shared test results from her doctor. The women burst into celebration on hearing the news.
## Her message

In her post, Adesua said she had been quieter than usual this year because she was going through some of the most difficult months of her life, describing one procedure after another, tests, scans and hospital visits. She said the year had thrown everything at her but that she was not easily broken, and thanked God for carrying her through. She said there was more to her testimony that she would share later.
Some reports said she had been declared cancer-free, though she did not give details of her diagnosis in the post.
## How fans reacted
Fans and colleagues have flooded her page with congratulatory messages and prayers.

stories.h: Annie Macaulay cheers 2Baba's new album, sparking reconciliation talk
stories.p: Actress Annie Macaulay has publicly supported her ex-husband 2Baba as he announced his new album, Oldest Young Man. Her comment set off speculation online about their relationship.
body: Actress Annie Macaulay has got social media talking after publicly supporting her ex-husband, Innocent Idibia, popularly known as 2Baba, over his new album.
## The album
On Thursday, 26 November 2026, 2Baba announced on Instagram that his long-awaited album, Oldest Young Man, would be released at midnight.
## Annie's comment

Among those cheering him on in the comments was Annie, who wished him more blessings and hyped the album title. Her message quickly drew attention, with many fans debating what it said about the former couple's relationship and some speculating about a possible reconciliation.
## Background
The couple's marriage ended after a public split, and they share children. This week, the singer also made headlines for his comments on the 'rig and die' election slogan.

stories.h: Fashola says Tinubu stands out because he has kept his allies for 16 years
stories.p: Former Lagos Governor Babatunde Fashola has argued that President Tinubu differs from Atiku Abubakar and Peter Obi because he has kept the loyalty of his political allies for about 16 years. He said even former opponents now work with him.
body: Former Lagos State Governor Babatunde Fashola has made a case for President Bola Tinubu's re-election, arguing that he stands apart from his main rivals by keeping his political allies for about 16 years.
## The comparison

Speaking in a television interview on Friday, 27 November 2026, Fashola noted that Tinubu, Atiku Abubakar and Peter Obi all began their political rise as state governors, although Atiku was elected governor but did not serve. He framed his argument as a job reference question, saying that Tinubu's long-time allies have stayed with him.
He also said that even some of the president's fiercest former opponents now work with him.
## Background

Fashola, who succeeded Tinubu as Lagos governor and later served as a federal minister, also condemned the 'rig and die' slogan in the same interview. Atiku and Obi are expected to sign an opposition cooperation pact at a summit in Abuja on Monday.
## The other side
No response from the Atiku or Obi campaigns was included in the reports.
## Lagos in 2023

Fashola also admitted that the APC was caught off guard when Peter Obi won Lagos in the 2023 presidential election, saying internal surveys had not flagged the state as one to defend hard, and vowed that the party would not let it happen again.
more: Fashola says Tinubu has kept allies for 16 years.

stories.h: Obi urges mothers to pray for Nigeria and guard their votes
stories.p: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi has appealed to Nigerian mothers to pray for the country and to stay behind after voting to make sure their votes are counted. He spoke at an ECWA women's fellowship in Abuja.
body: Peter Obi, the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) presidential candidate, has appealed to Nigerian mothers to pray for the country and to protect their votes at the 2027 elections.
## What he said

Speaking at an ECWA Women Fellowship event in Abuja, Obi expressed concern about rising poverty, unemployment and insecurity. He said Nigeria now has the highest number of people living in poverty in the world, that millions of young people are unemployed, and that mothers are suffering because of insecurity.
He urged the women, after voting for the candidate of their choice on election day, to stay behind at polling units to make sure their votes are counted.
## A warm welcome
Videos from the convention showed women rushing excitedly to greet him.
## Background
Obi is expected to attend an opposition summit in Abuja on Monday, where he, Atiku Abubakar and Seyi Makinde are due to sign a cooperation pact.

stories.h: Naira gains ₦19 to ₦1,378 per dollar after CBN raises BDC limit
stories.p: The naira strengthened by ₦19 to close at ₦1,378 per dollar on the official market on Thursday, after the CBN raised the weekly dollar sales limit for bureaux de change. It had lost over ₦43 in the previous two weeks.
body: The naira recovered strongly against the US dollar on the official foreign exchange market on Thursday, 26 November 2026.
## The rebound

The currency gained ₦19 to close at ₦1,378 per dollar, up from ₦1,397 on Wednesday. The recovery reversed some of the losses it suffered between 13 and 25 November, when it fell by ₦43.50 amid rising demand for dollars.
## Why

The gain followed the Central Bank of Nigeria's decision to raise the weekly dollar cash purchase limit for Bureau De Change operators from $150,000 to $1 million, aimed at easing seasonal pressure on the market.
## Background
The CBN this week kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 23%.
more: The naira closed at ₦1,378 on Thursday.
It gained ₦19 in a day.
The CBN raised the BDC dollar limit to $1m.

stories.h: Kwankwaso accuses Kano Governor Abba Yusuf of using EFCC to target him
stories.p: NDC vice-presidential candidate Rabiu Kwankwaso has accused his former protégé, Kano Governor Abba Yusuf, of trying to bring him down through anti-corruption agencies ahead of 2027. He claimed the governor asked the EFCC to act against him.
body: Rabiu Kwankwaso, the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) vice-presidential candidate and former governor of Kano State, has publicly accused Kano Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf of plotting against him through anti-corruption agencies ahead of the 2027 elections.
## The accusation

In a statement on his X account on Friday, 27 November 2026, Kwankwaso claimed that the governor, who served under him for decades as an aide and commissioner, had formally asked the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) to act against him. He alleged that when that effort failed, the governor turned to a little-known group to stage protests at the EFCC's office to put pressure on the agency.
Kwankwaso said the governor wanted to damage his reputation.
## Background

The two men, once close allies, have fallen out since Yusuf defected from the NNPP to the APC in January 2026. In recent days the governor claimed that Kwankwaso once sent him to promise President Tinubu they would rejoin the APC, a claim the Kwankwasiyya Movement has rejected. Yusuf has also spoken publicly about the end of his marriage to Kwankwaso's niece.
## The other side
No response from Governor Yusuf or the EFCC to Kwankwaso's claims was included in the reports.
## Kano government responds

The Kano State Government has rejected Kwankwaso's claims. In a statement, the Commissioner for Information said the governor had no involvement in Kwankwaso's dealings with the EFCC, which it said predate the current administration, and accused him of trying to win public sympathy.
## 'Predates this government'

In a television interview on Friday, the Kano Commissioner for Information denied that the EFCC was being used against Kwankwaso by either the state or federal government, saying his issues with anti-corruption agencies predated Governor Yusuf's time in office.
more: Kwankwaso says Yusuf asked the EFCC to act against him.
He alleges protests were staged at the EFCC.
The governor had not responded.

stories.h: Netflix removes Tyson Fury schizophrenia claim from documentary
stories.p: Netflix has removed references to schizophrenia from its Tyson Fury documentary after it emerged the boxer has not been medically diagnosed with the condition. The claim had come from his wife, Paris.
body: Netflix has removed references to schizophrenia from its upcoming documentary about boxer Tyson Fury, after it emerged that he has not been medically diagnosed with the condition.
## What changed

In the original version of the 90-minute film, Fury's wife, Paris, said doctors had regarded him as a mild schizophrenic in the year after he beat Wladimir Klitschko in November 2015. Those references have now been taken out. The documentary premieres on Netflix on Friday, 27 November 2026.
## Boxing board concerns

The British Boxing Board of Control, which is sanctioning Fury's fight with Anthony Joshua on 11 December, had raised concerns about his mental health after the original statements. Its rules bar boxers from fighting if they have certain psychological disorders.
## Background

Fury struggled with depression, drug and alcohol problems after the Klitschko win and did not return to the ring for nearly three years. He has spoken openly about his mental health, including bipolar disorder. An earlier story on this site said he had been diagnosed with schizophrenia; that report has been corrected.
## Cleared to fight

The British Boxing Board of Control has since cleared Fury to face Anthony Joshua, saying he passed all up-to-date medical checks. His wife, Paris, has retracted her claim, saying he was never diagnosed by any doctor.
more: Fury has not been medically diagnosed with schizophrenia.
The claim came from his wife in the film.
He fights Anthony Joshua on 11 December.

stories.h: Fashola says no one should die for rigging elections
stories.p: Former Lagos Governor Babatunde Fashola has condemned the 'rig and die' slogan, saying death is not the penalty for electoral offences. He backed tougher prison terms instead.
body: Former Lagos State Governor Babatunde Fashola has condemned the 'rig and die' slogan ahead of the 2027 elections, insisting that nobody should lose their life over electoral offences.
## What he said

In a television interview that aired on Friday, 27 November 2026, Fashola, a Senior Advocate of Nigeria, said the punishment for rigging under the Electoral Act is not death. He added that even if it were, which he would not support, there must be a process, including a charge, a trial and a chance to defend oneself, before a life is taken.

He nevertheless said electoral manipulation should attract serious consequences, suggesting tougher prison sentences without the option of a fine for offences that undermine democracy, and urged politicians to campaign rather than rig.
## Background

The slogan has sparked a national debate. INEC has warned it could incite mob attacks at polling units, while singer 2Baba said this week he saw nothing wrong with it and backed severe punishment for riggers. Fashola's comments drew mixed reactions online.
more: Fashola says death is not the penalty for rigging.
He backs tougher prison terms instead.
His comments drew mixed reactions.

stories.h: INEC names nine states as hotspots for campaign violence
stories.p: INEC Chairman Joash Amupitan has listed Lagos, Edo, Ekiti, Enugu, Ebonyi, Delta, Cross River, Oyo and Benue as states hit by campaign violence and political intolerance. He warned that the unrest could threaten preparations for the 2027 elections.
body: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has named nine states as hotspots for campaign violence and political intolerance ahead of the 2027 general elections.
## The states

INEC Chairman Professor Joash Amupitan listed Lagos, Edo, Ekiti, Enugu, Ebonyi, Delta, Cross River, Oyo and Benue. He spoke on Wednesday in Abuja at a strategic election security conference organised with the Office of the National Security Adviser and attended by the heads of security agencies.
## What he said

Amupitan said campaign convoys, town hall meetings, party offices and supporters had all come under attack in the listed states. He warned that the growing unrest could jeopardise preparations for the elections, and also raised concern about harassment, intimidation and assault of INEC officials and staff.
## Background

The warning follows a series of violent incidents this month, including deadly attacks on NDC campaign events in Delta and Edo states. A civic group this week recorded 124 cases of electoral violence and 22 deaths since July, and INEC has also cautioned against the 'rig and die' slogan.
more: INEC lists nine violence hotspot states.
Delta, Edo and Lagos are among them.
INEC staff have also been harassed.

stories.h: Dangote cuts cooking gas price to ₦1,000 per kg, but retail prices stay high
stories.p: Dangote Refinery has reportedly cut its cooking gas gantry price to ₦1,000 per kg, with its marketers selling at ₦1,100. Consumers, however, are still paying between ₦1,600 and ₦1,800 per kg at retail outlets.
body: Dangote Petroleum Refinery has reportedly reduced the wholesale price of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), commonly known as cooking gas, to ₦1,000 per kilogram.
## The new prices
Marketers linked to the refinery have lowered their selling price to ₦1,100 per kilogram, according to a market survey.
## The retail gap

Despite the cuts, consumers are still paying between ₦1,600 and ₦1,800 per kilogram at retail outlets, raising concerns about the gap between wholesale and retail prices. Earlier this week, cooking gas was reported to be selling for up to ₦2,000 per kg in parts of Abuja.
## Background
The refinery has also cut its petrol and diesel prices in recent weeks, most recently reducing diesel by ₦125 to ₦1,595 per litre.
more: Dangote's gantry price is now ₦1,000 per kg.
Its marketers sell at ₦1,100.
Retail prices remain ₦1,600–₦1,800.

stories.h: NNPC cuts petrol price by ₦60 to ₦1,240 per litre in Abuja
stories.p: NNPC has reportedly reduced its petrol pump price from ₦1,300 to ₦1,240 per litre at outlets in Abuja, undercutting rivals. The cut comes amid intense competition among marketers.
body: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPCL) has reduced its petrol pump price again, as competition among marketers intensifies.
## The new price

A market survey on Thursday, 26 November 2026, showed that NNPC cut its price from ₦1,300 to ₦1,240 per litre, a reduction of ₦60. The new price was seen at several NNPC stations across the Federal Capital Territory, including Gwarinpa, the Kubwa Expressway, Airport Junction and Wuse Zone 6.
## Competition

The cut undercuts other major marketers such as MRS and AA Rano, which have also reduced prices in recent days. Wholesale prices have fallen sharply, with some Lagos depots selling at about ₦1,055 per litre.
## Background
Prices have been falling for weeks amid competition between Dangote Refinery and importers.
more: NNPC's Abuja price falls to ₦1,240.
The cut is ₦60 per litre.
Rivals have also reduced prices.

stories.h: Shettima says Obi failed to transform his own hometown as governor
stories.p: Vice President Kashim Shettima has reportedly mocked Peter Obi, saying he governed Anambra for eight years without transforming his hometown, Agulu. He praised Governor Chukwuma Soludo for dualising the road there.
body: Vice President Kashim Shettima has reportedly taken a swipe at NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi, questioning why his hometown, Agulu, was not transformed during his eight years as governor of Anambra State.
## What he said

Shettima made the remarks at a town hall meeting with traditional rulers in Isuofia, Anambra State, where he praised Governor Chukwuma Soludo for infrastructure projects. He credited Soludo, who is from Isuofia, with dualising the road linking Agulu to Ekwulobia, saying it took another governor to transform the road to Obi's hometown.
## Background
Shettima has been campaigning in Anambra for President Tinubu's re-election. He recently said he would keep firing back at Atiku Abubakar as long as he attacks the president.
## The other side
No response from Obi or the NDC was included in the reports.
more: Shettima spoke in Isuofia, Anambra.
He praised Soludo for the Agulu road.
Obi's camp had not responded.

stories.h: 2Baba says election riggers deserve severe punishment amid 'rig and die' debate
stories.p: Singer 2Baba has said he supports tough punishment for anyone who manipulates election results, as debate continues over the 'rig and die' slogan. He said the slogan reflects Nigerians' frustration.
body: Music star Innocent Idibia, popularly known as 2Baba, has weighed in on the controversial 'rig and die' slogan ahead of the 2027 elections.
## What he said

Speaking in a radio interview on Thursday, 26 November 2026, the African Queen singer said he supported severe punishment for anyone who tries to manipulate election results, arguing that serious consequences would discourage others from electoral malpractice.
He described the national mood as tense, and said the slogan reflected the desperation and frustration many Nigerians feel. He also said he did not see anything wrong with the slogan itself.
## Background

The phrase 'rig and die' has spread widely online and at rallies. Earlier this week, INEC warned that it was dangerous, saying a slogan linking an electoral offence to death could incite mob attacks at polling units and put voters and election staff at risk. A civic group has also recorded 124 cases of electoral violence since July.
more: 2Baba backs tough penalties for riggers.
He says the slogan reflects public frustration.
INEC has warned the slogan is dangerous.

stories.h: Ebuka Obi sparks debate with ₦2bn appeal to renovate Zion Ministry
stories.p: Cleric Ebuka Obi has drawn reactions after appealing for ₦2 billion to renovate his church in Lagos and hitting back at critics of members who donate to the ministry.
body: Cleric Ebuka Obi has sparked reactions online after appealing for ₦2 billion in donations to renovate his church, Zion Ministry, in Lagos.
## What he said

In a sermon clip that has circulated online, the cleric defended church members who donate to the ministry, and criticised people who mock them online. He accused critics of being jealous of those who choose to give, saying they were not the ones providing the money and had no business worrying about how others spend theirs.
## How people reacted
His comments, and the size of the fundraising appeal, have drawn wide attention, with many people debating church donations amid the country's economic hardship.
## How people reacted
His comments, and the size of the fundraising appeal, have drawn wide reactions online.
more: Ebuka Obi wants ₦2bn to renovate his church.
He criticised people who mock donors.
The appeal has sparked debate.

stories.h: Trump calls for probe after US growth figure is revised upward
stories.p: President Donald Trump has demanded an investigation after official figures revised US third-quarter growth up to 4.3%, claiming without evidence that the earlier figure was deliberately understated before the midterms.
body: US President Donald Trump has called for an immediate investigation into an upward revision of US economic growth figures.
## The revision

On Wednesday, the US Commerce Department's Bureau of Economic Analysis revised annualised growth for the third quarter to 4.3%, up from its earlier estimate of 3.4% released on 29 October. Such revisions are a standard part of the process as more complete data becomes available.
## Trump's claim

In a post on Truth Social on Thursday, 26 November 2026, Trump branded the earlier, pre-election figure fake and asked why the correct number was not released before the 3 November midterm elections. He claimed, without evidence, that the earlier figure had been deliberately understated.
## Background
Trump's Republican Party suffered heavy losses in the midterms, with Democrats winning control of both the House and the Senate.
more: Q3 growth was revised up to 4.3% from 3.4%.
Trump called the earlier figure fake.
He offered no evidence.

stories.h: Makinde camp denies claim he will step down for Atiku
stories.p: Oyo Governor Seyi Makinde's campaign has dismissed as fake a claim that he plans to withdraw his presidential bid in favour of Atiku Abubakar on 30 November. The claim was made by a political commentator.
body: The campaign of Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde has dismissed as fake news a claim that he plans to drop his 2027 presidential bid in favour of former Vice President Atiku Abubakar.
## The claim

Political commentator Lere Olayinka had written that Makinde, the Allied Peoples Movement (APM) candidate, would step down for Atiku on 30 November, the date of the opposition parties' summit in Abuja.
## The denial

On Thursday, 26 November 2026, the verified X account linked to Makinde's campaign rejected the claim and accused the ruling APC of spreading falsehoods. The post drew both support and criticism from social media users.
## Background

Makinde said this week that he remains open to working with Atiku and Peter Obi to unseat President Tinubu, but ruled out a formal merger of parties. Opposition parties are due to hold their second summit in Abuja on Monday. No response from the APC to the accusation was included in the reports.
more: Makinde's camp calls the claim fake news.
It accused the APC of spreading lies.
The opposition summit holds on 30 November.

stories.h: Babangida tells Tinubu's delegation he is pleased with the president's work
stories.p: A presidential delegation led by Chief of Staff Femi Gbajabiamila visited former military leaders Ibrahim Babangida and Abdulsalami Abubakar in Minna. Babangida reportedly said he was pleased with the president's performance.
body: President Bola Tinubu sent a delegation to Minna, Niger State, on Thursday, 26 November 2026, to visit former military Head of State General Ibrahim Babangida and former Head of State General Abdulsalami Abubakar.
## The visit

The delegation was led by the Chief of Staff to the President, Femi Gbajabiamila, who announced the visit on X. He said it was made at the president's directive and that the delegation conveyed Tinubu's best wishes to both leaders, who he said looked well and in high spirits.
## Babangida's message
General Babangida reportedly told the delegation that he was pleased with the president's administration.
## Background
The visit comes as campaigns for the January 2027 elections intensify.

stories.h: NDC deputy governorship candidate in Ebonyi defects to APC
stories.p: The NDC's deputy governorship candidate in Ebonyi State, Uka Chris Ndubuisi, has reportedly left the party and joined the APC. He announced the move at an APC campaign rally.
body: The Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) deputy governorship candidate in Ebonyi State, Ambassador Uka Chris Ndubuisi, has reportedly left the party and joined the All Progressives Congress (APC).
## The announcement

Ndubuisi made the announcement on Thursday, 26 November 2026, at an APC governorship campaign rally in the state. He pledged his loyalty to President Bola Tinubu and Governor Francis Nwifuru, and said the decision was entirely his own.
## The welcome
Governor Nwifuru, Minister of Works David Umahi, who is a former governor of the state, and APC supporters were present to welcome him into the party.
## The other side
No response from the NDC to the defection was included in the reports. Defections between parties have been common as the 2027 campaigns gather pace.
more: He joined the APC at a campaign rally.
He pledged loyalty to Tinubu and Nwifuru.

stories.h: Nathaniel Bassey builds apartments for his staff and musicians
stories.p: Gospel singer Nathaniel Bassey has unveiled a housing project, Love Song Apartments, built for his staff and musicians. He said he hopes they will move in with their families before Christmas.
body: Gospel singer Nathaniel Bassey has drawn praise after revealing that he built apartments to help members of his team become homeowners.
## The project

In an Instagram post, Bassey said the housing project, named Love Song Apartments, was created for his staff and musicians. He said he was particularly excited at the prospect of the beneficiaries moving into their new homes with their families before Christmas.
## Why he did it
The singer described the project as more than providing accommodation, saying it was a way of making sure the people who work with him share in the fruits of their joint efforts.
## How people reacted
Pictures of the apartments have been widely shared online.
more: The project is called Love Song Apartments.
It is for his staff and musicians.
He hopes they move in before Christmas.

stories.h: Aubameyang crashes Ferrari on way to training in Spain, no serious injuries
stories.p: Former Arsenal striker Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang was involved in a crash on his way to training with Deportivo La Coruña. His Ferrari collided with another car, but no one was seriously hurt.
body: Former Arsenal and Chelsea striker Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang was involved in a road accident on his way to training with his Spanish club, Deportivo La Coruña, on Thursday, 26 November 2026.
## The crash

The 37-year-old Gabon international was driving a Ferrari, reportedly worth around €380,000, when it collided with a BMW on the AP-9 motorway in north-west Spain at about 9:30am local time. The BMW overturned in the impact and had to be towed away.
## No serious injuries
Emergency services, including the Civil Guard, firefighters and paramedics, attended the scene. Despite the force of the collision, no one was seriously injured.
more: His Ferrari collided with a BMW.

No one was seriously injured.

stories.h: Tinubu promises ₦100m and a house to each family of NAF plane crash victims
stories.p: President Tinubu has pledged ₦100 million and a three-bedroom flat to every family that lost a loved one in the NAF 931 aircraft crash in Ondo. He spoke at a memorial ceremony in Abuja.
body: President Bola Tinubu has announced a support package of ₦100 million and a three-bedroom flat for each family that lost a loved one in the crash of the Nigerian Air Force aircraft NAF 931 in Ondo State.
## The pledge

The president made the announcement at a memorial and wreath-laying ceremony in Abuja held in honour of the victims. The package covers the families of both the military personnel and the civilians who died in the crash.
## Military support
Tinubu also assured the armed forces that the government would provide better training and equipment to improve the performance and readiness of personnel.
more: Each family gets ₦100 million and a three-bedroom flat.
The pledge covers military and civilian victims.
Tinubu promised better training and equipment.

stories.h: Atiku, Obi and Makinde to sign opposition pact at Abuja summit on Monday
stories.p: Atiku Abubakar, Peter Obi and Seyi Makinde are expected to lead their parties to an opposition summit in Abuja on Monday, 30 November, to formalise a cooperation pact against President Tinubu. Participating parties will suspend campaigns that day.
body: The Coalition for Democracy has confirmed that the second summit of Nigeria's opposition political parties will hold on Monday, 30 November 2026, at the NAF Conference Centre in Abuja.
## The details

Proceedings will begin at 10am, with accreditation opening at 9am. The confirmation followed the seventh meeting of the coalition's central leadership committee on Wednesday, 26 November. The statement was signed on behalf of the coalition parties by Salihu Lukman.
## What to expect
The summit is expected to adopt three key documents and deliberate on democratic renewal, party unity and electoral integrity ahead of the 2027 elections.
## Background
The summit was earlier moved to 30 November. Oyo Governor Seyi Makinde said this week that he was open to working with Atiku Abubakar and Peter Obi to unseat President Tinubu.
## The unity pact

According to the coalition's convener, the summit is meant to move opposition parties from talks to binding commitments. Atiku of the ADC, Obi of the NDC and Makinde of the APM are expected to attend with their parties, alongside the PRP, the SDP and a faction of the PDP. Donald Duke of the PRP is also expected. Participating parties have agreed to suspend campaigns nationwide on Monday so that leaders can attend. Makinde's camp has denied claims that he plans to step down for Atiku.
more: Atiku, Obi and Makinde are expected to attend.
Parties will suspend campaigns on Monday.
They plan to adopt three key documents.

stories.h: Atiku attacks Tinubu over ₦842bn energy bill paid by 11 manufacturers
stories.p: ADC candidate Atiku Abubakar has reportedly criticised the Tinubu government over reports that just 11 listed manufacturers spent ₦842 billion on energy in nine months. He said Nigeria had become too costly to produce in.
body: Former Vice President Atiku Abubakar, the African Democratic Congress (ADC) presidential candidate, has reportedly criticised President Bola Tinubu's government over the rising cost of energy.
## What he said

In a statement issued on Thursday, 26 November 2026, by his director of strategic communication, Atiku is said to have argued that the government had made Nigeria too costly to produce in, too costly to build in and too expensive for ordinary families to live in.
His remarks followed reports that only 11 manufacturers listed on the stock exchange spent ₦842 billion on energy in the first nine months of 2026.
## The other side
No response from the presidency or the APC was included in the reports.
## Background
Atiku's campaign has issued a series of attacks on the government's economic record in recent days, including over a drop in oil revenue.

Atiku says Nigeria is too costly to produce in.

stories.h: Benin photographer Sh0tbySav reportedly dies after 'one-chance' attack
stories.p: A photographer known as Sh0tbySav has reportedly died in Benin City after being robbed and pushed out of a moving vehicle by suspected 'one-chance' criminals. Fellow photographers are mourning her.
body: The photography community in Benin City, Edo State, is mourning after reports that a photographer known as Sh0tbySav died following a suspected 'one-chance' robbery.
## What reportedly happened

According to accounts shared on social media, she was returning home after a photoshoot for a client when she boarded a commercial vehicle believed to have been operated by criminals. She was reportedly robbed of her belongings and pushed out of the moving vehicle.
Details of the incident remain limited, and no police statement was included in the reports.
## A warning

Her death has drawn fresh attention to the dangers posed by 'one-chance' gangs, criminals who pose as commercial drivers and passengers to rob unsuspecting commuters, a recurring problem in several Nigerian cities.
## Tributes
Fellow photographers have shared tributes online.
more: She was reportedly pushed from a moving vehicle.

stories.h: Farooq Oreagba says he is being treated for incurable cancer, expects remission by spring
stories.p: NG Clearing MD Farooq Oreagba has reportedly revealed he is undergoing treatment for an incurable form of cancer diagnosed in February. He said treatment is going well and he expects to be in remission by March or April.
body: Businessman Farooq Oreagba, managing director of NG Clearing Limited, has reportedly shared an update on his health, saying he is undergoing treatment for an incurable form of cancer.
## What he said

In an interview, Oreagba said the condition was diagnosed after a medical screening on 4 February 2026. The 60-year-old said he had continued working and living normally, and that his treatment was progressing well.

He explained that his condition is one that comes and goes with treatment, and that he has learned to manage it without letting it stop him from pursuing his interests. He said he expected to be back in remission by March or April.
## Background
He has previously spoken about his long experience with cancer and the daily routine that keeps him strong.

stories.h: Elon Musk promises two SpaceX shares to every child in America
stories.p: Elon Musk has said every child in the United States will receive two SpaceX shares, one from the company and one from him personally. He did not explain how the plan would work.
body: Elon Musk has said every child in the United States will receive two shares in SpaceX, doubling a pledge he made last month.
## The pledge

In a post on X on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, Musk said one share would come from the company and one from him personally. He said the company-funded share would be transferred next month, with his personal contribution following in June next year.
## Questions remain

Musk did not explain how children would qualify, how the shares would be distributed or who would manage them on their behalf. He advised recipients to hold on to their shares, claiming SpaceX could one day be worth vastly more than today's global economy if it achieves its long-term goals.
## Background
In October, Musk promised every American child one SpaceX share, describing it at the time as the first of many.
more: One share from SpaceX and one from Musk himself.
He did not explain how it will work.
It doubles an October pledge.

stories.h: FIFA says hackers stole personal and business information in cyberattack
stories.p: FIFA has confirmed it was the victim of a cyberattack in which criminals gained access to a limited set of personal and business information. It is working with law enforcement.
body: World football's governing body FIFA has confirmed that it was hit by a cyberattack in which hackers gained unauthorised access to personal and business information.
## What FIFA said

In a statement on Thursday, 26 November 2026, FIFA said it had been the victim of a criminal cyberattack that gave access to a limited set of personal and business information. It said it was working with the relevant authorities, including law enforcement, to investigate.

The organisation strongly condemned the unlawful taking and publication of the information, particularly personal data, describing it as a serious violation of privacy that could have significant consequences for the people affected.
## Unanswered questions
FIFA did not say when the attack happened, what kind of information was accessed or how many people were affected.
more: FIFA confirmed the breach on Thursday.
Personal and business data were accessed.

stories.h: Several killed as commercial bus catches fire on Lagos-Badagry Expressway
stories.p: Several passengers died and more than a dozen were injured when a commercial bus burst into flames at Magbon on the Lagos-Badagry Expressway on Thursday morning. Officials gave death tolls of six and eight.
body: Several people were killed and others injured when a commercial bus caught fire on the Lagos-Badagry Expressway on Thursday morning, 26 November 2026.
## What happened

The incident happened near the Checkpoint area, inward Magbon, between 8am and 9am. The bus, travelling from Mile 2 towards Badagry, reportedly suffered brake failure, and the driver lost control. The vehicle somersaulted and burst into flames, trapping passengers inside.
## The toll

Officials gave different figures. The Lagos State Fire and Rescue Service put the death toll at six adults, two women and four men, with 12 others injured. The Lagos State Traffic Management Authority (LASTMA) said eight passengers died and 13 suffered severe burns. The injured were taken to Badagry General Hospital.
## Driver fled

The LASTMA general manager said the driver fled the scene after the crash, leaving passengers trapped, and offered condolences to the families of the victims. Traffic and road safety officers were deployed to the scene.
more: Officials put the death toll at six to eight.

stories.h: At least 16 killed in gunmen attack on Plateau community
stories.p: Gunmen have killed at least 16 people, including women and children, in an attack on a community in Bassa Local Government Area of Plateau State, according to a local association. Four others were injured.
body: At least 16 people, including women, young people and children, have reportedly been killed in an attack on a community in Bassa Local Government Area of Plateau State.
## The attack

According to the Irigwe Development Association, gunmen armed with assault rifles stormed the Tafi Gana community near Miango at about 11:30pm on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, and opened fire. By dawn on Thursday, 16 people were dead and four others had been taken to hospital with injuries.
## Background
The attack is the latest in a series of deadly incidents in Plateau State, including in Bokkos, where gunmen set a secondary school on fire earlier this week.
## Response
No statement from the police or the state government on the attack was included in the initial reports.
## More details

Residents said the attack on Tafi-Gana in Jebbu Miango continued into the early hours of Thursday. One resident said 16 bodies were recovered at the scene and that three more victims later died. Community leaders urged residents to stay calm as security agencies investigate.
more: At least 16 people were killed.
The attack happened late on Wednesday.
Four others were injured.

stories.h: Dangote Refinery cuts diesel price by ₦125 per litre
stories.p: Dangote Refinery has reduced its diesel gantry price from ₦1,720 to ₦1,595 per litre, effective Thursday. It comes days after it suspended a planned ₦150 cut, and ahead of its stock market listing.
body: Dangote Petroleum Refinery has reduced the gantry price of diesel by ₦125 per litre nationwide.
## The new price

The cut, effective from Thursday, 26 November 2026, lowers the price at the refinery from ₦1,720 to ₦1,595 per litre, a reduction of about 7%. The refinery said the change would reduce energy and haulage costs for manufacturers, transporters and marketers, and that customers' accounts would be credited accordingly.
## Background

The refinery had announced a ₦150 cut earlier this month but suspended it on 21 November pending an internal review. It has also cut its petrol price several times in recent weeks, amid growing competition with importers.
## Stock market debut
The price cut comes ahead of the refinery's planned listing on the Nigerian Exchange on 1 December, after its oversubscribed public offering.
more: Diesel falls from ₦1,720 to ₦1,595 per litre.
An earlier ₦150 cut was suspended.

stories.h: NERC warns DisCos not to charge customers for free meters
stories.p: The electricity regulator has warned distribution companies not to charge customers for meters supplied under its ₦30 billion Meter Acquisition Fund. Both the meters and installation must be free.
body: The Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission (NERC) has warned electricity distribution companies (DisCos) not to charge customers for meters supplied under its ₦30 billion Meter Acquisition Fund.
## The rules

In an order on the third tranche of the scheme, NERC said both the meters and their installation must be free for eligible customers. The tranche covers all 11 DisCos, prioritising unmetered Band A customers and extending to Band B customers.
Every meter supplied under the scheme must display the name of the relevant DisCo and the tranche of the fund it came from.
## Sanctions
The regulator warned that DisCos could face penalties if their actions or failure to meet requirements delay installations.
more: Meters and installation must be free.
Band A customers are prioritised.

stories.h: Wike mocks Atiku for running for president since age 47
stories.p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly questioned Atiku Abubakar's latest presidential bid, saying the ADC candidate has been running for the office since he was 47. Atiku turned 80 on Wednesday.
body: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly taken aim at Atiku Abubakar's repeated bids for the presidency, saying he has been seeking the office since he was 47.

Speaking at a Rainbow Coalition town hall in Gokana Local Government Area of Rivers State on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, Wike questioned why Atiku was running again in 2027 on the platform of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) after several unsuccessful attempts on different party platforms over the decades.
He pointed to Atiku's involvement in presidential contests across several parties, including 1993, 2007, 2011, 2015, 2019 and 2023.

Atiku turned 80 on Wednesday, the same day President Tinubu sent him a birthday message.

No response from Atiku's campaign was included in the reports.

stories.h: US appeals court gives Trump new route to challenge hush money conviction
stories.p: A US federal appeals court has revived Donald Trump's bid to move his New York hush money case into federal court, where he hopes to have it dismissed on presidential immunity grounds.
body: A US federal appeals court has given President Donald Trump a fresh opening to try to overturn his New York hush money conviction.
## The ruling

In a short order issued on Monday, 23 November 2026, a three-judge panel of the 2nd US Circuit Court of Appeals sent the dispute back to a federal district court in Manhattan, instructing a judge to rule quickly on Trump's request to transfer the case to federal court.
The panel found that the previous judge had been wrong to conclude that moving a case to federal court after conviction was never possible.
## What Trump wants
If the case is transferred, Trump intends to seek its dismissal on presidential immunity grounds. Any decision could later return to the 2nd Circuit.

stories.h: Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie settle long legal battle over French winery
stories.p: Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie have settled their years-long dispute over Château Miraval out of court. The terms were not disclosed.
body: Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie have settled their long-running legal battle over the sale of their French winery, Château Miraval.
## The settlement

In a joint statement on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, the former couple said they had resolved the case out of court in the best interests of their family and would not comment further. They added that any comments attributed to anonymous sources did not come from either of them or anyone close to them. The terms of the settlement were not disclosed.
## The dispute

Pitt, 62, and Jolie, 51, bought the estate in the south of France in 2008 and had been in dispute over it since they split in 2016. In 2022, Pitt sued Jolie, claiming they had agreed that neither would sell their share without the other's consent, and accusing her of selling her stake to a Russian businessman without his permission. Jolie disputed his account in her response.

stories.h: Pep Guardiola says coaching a national team is his next step
stories.p: Former Manchester City manager Pep Guardiola has said he wants to coach a national team next. He revealed he turned down Italy in the summer because the timing was not right.
body: Pep Guardiola has said that coaching a national team is the next step in his career.
## What he said

In an interview with Brazilian legend and former teammate Romario, the 55-year-old was asked whether there was a team he had never coached but would like to. He replied that he wanted to lead a national team, describing it as his next step.
## Italy offer
Guardiola revealed that he had talks with Italy over the summer and described the approach as one of the greatest honours of his career, but said the timing was not right.
## What next

Guardiola left Manchester City at the end of the 2025-26 season after ten years at the club, ending an 18-year career in club football. Reports earlier this month suggested U.S. Soccer would make him a top target to replace Mauricio Pochettino, who left the US job to manage Manchester United.

He turned down Italy in the summer.

stories.h: Three inmates died during Ilorin jailbreak attempt, correctional service says
stories.p: The Nigerian Correctional Service says three inmates died during last week's attempted jailbreak at the Medium Security Custodial Centre in Ilorin. Two death-row inmates escaped and five others were stopped.
body: The Nigerian Correctional Service (NCoS) has said three inmates died during the recent jailbreak attempt at the Medium Security Custodial Centre in Ilorin, Kwara State.
## What happened

Speaking during a visit to Ilorin on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, the Controller-General of Corrections, Sylvester Nwakuche, said seven inmates tried to escape on 18 November. Officers stopped five of them, but two death-row inmates succeeded after reportedly breaking through and scaling the wall of the facility.
He said the service had been informed that three of the five who failed to escape had died, describing it as an unfortunate incident.
## Investigation

Nwakuche said the Minister of Interior, Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo, had ordered an investigation, and a team had been set up to look into the incident thoroughly. He said anyone found to be involved would face the law. About 20 officers were earlier reported to be under investigation over the escape.
more: Seven inmates tried to escape on 18 November.

stories.h: Travellers raise privacy fears over 'no NIN, no flight' rule
stories.p: Concerns are growing among air travellers over the government's plan to require NIN verification for domestic flights from 1 January 2027. Critics worry about data privacy and passengers without NINs.
body: Anxiety is growing among Nigerian air travellers over the federal government's plan to make National Identification Number (NIN) verification compulsory for domestic flights from 1 January 2027.
## The policy

The rule will be enforced through the Verified Passenger Access System (VPASS), a biometric facial recognition platform. Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo has directed domestic airlines to connect to the system before the January deadline. The government says it will help stop ticket fraud and ensure passenger lists are accurate.
## The concerns
The policy has raised worries about data privacy, freedom of movement and the possible exclusion of passengers who do not yet have a NIN.
more: The rule starts on 1 January 2027.

stories.h: RCCG opens dialysis centre at UBTH, donates three machines
stories.p: The Redeemed Christian Church of God has opened a dialysis centre at the University of Benin Teaching Hospital and donated three dialysis machines. It is the 15th such centre its foundation has set up or supported.
body: The Redeemed Christian Church of God (RCCG) has commissioned a new dialysis centre at the University of Benin Teaching Hospital (UBTH) in Benin City, Edo State.
## The centre

The facility, named the Enoch and Folu Adeboye Dialysis Centre, was unveiled on Tuesday, 24 November 2026, by the church's social responsibility arm, His Love Foundation. The church donated three dialysis machines to boost kidney care at the hospital.
## Why it matters
The centre is expected to increase the hospital's capacity to provide haemodialysis to patients with kidney disease.
## Background
It is the 15th dialysis centre the foundation has established or supported across Nigeria.
more: The centre is named after Pastor and Mrs Adeboye.

stories.h: Report records 124 cases of electoral violence and 22 deaths in four months
stories.p: A civic group says it has documented 124 incidents of election-related violence and 22 deaths across Nigeria since July. It warned the trend could worsen as the January 2027 elections approach.
body: A non-partisan civic organisation has warned of rising political violence in Nigeria, saying it recorded 124 cases of electoral violence and 22 deaths in the past four months.
## The figures

In a statement in Abuja on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, the Kimpact Development Initiative (KDI) said the incidents were documented between 1 July and 23 November 2026 through its election violence monitoring project. Incidents rose from three in July to 48 in October, with another 40 recorded in the first half of November alone.
## The warning

The group warned that the trend could worsen as the 16 January 2027 elections draw closer unless political parties, security agencies and other stakeholders take urgent action. It pointed to growing political intolerance and inflammatory rhetoric among politicians and their supporters as key triggers.
KDI stressed that the problem cuts across parties and should not be blamed on any single group, and urged candidates to restrain their supporters.
## Background

The report comes days after deadly attacks on NDC campaign events in Delta and Edo states, and after INEC warned that the popular 'rig and die' slogan could endanger polling staff and voters. The House of Representatives has also warned that a state of emergency may be needed in Delta if violence continues.
more: 124 incidents and 22 deaths since July.
Incidents rose sharply in October and November.
The group says the problem cuts across all parties.

stories.h: Makinde says he is open to working with Atiku and Obi to unseat Tinubu
stories.p: Oyo Governor and APM presidential candidate Seyi Makinde has reportedly said he remains open to an arrangement with Atiku Abubakar and Peter Obi to stop President Tinubu winning a second term. He ruled out a formal merger of parties.
body: Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde, the presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), has reportedly spoken about a possible political arrangement involving himself, the ADC's Atiku Abubakar and the NDC's Peter Obi, aimed at stopping President Bola Tinubu from winning a second term in 2027.
## No merger
Makinde is said to have made clear that what he has in mind would not be a formal coalition or merger of political parties, but he said he remains open to working with the two opposition candidates.
## Background
Earlier this week, Makinde said he believed Tinubu had only a 30% chance of re-election, citing economic hardship and insecurity.
## The other side
No response from the APC, Atiku or Obi to Makinde's comments was included in the reports.

stories.h: Spectranet to shut down services in Ibadan and Port Harcourt
stories.p: Internet provider Spectranet says it will end its broadband services in Ibadan and Port Harcourt after a six-month notice period, citing rising operating costs. It will focus on Lagos and Abuja.
body: Internet service provider Spectranet Limited has announced that it will discontinue its broadband services in Ibadan and Port Harcourt after a six-month notice period.
## What it means for users
The company said it would keep its network running and continue to provide customer support in both cities until the notice period ends, giving subscribers time to arrange alternative connections.
## Why

Spectranet said higher operating costs had made it increasingly difficult to maintain its service standards in the two cities. It plans to concentrate its resources in Lagos and Abuja, where it says it will work on improving network performance.

stories.h: Mr Latin hands over TAMPAN leadership to Ajala Jalingo after eight years
stories.p: Actor Bolaji Amusan, known as Mr Latin, has stepped down as president of the theatre and film practitioners' association TAMPAN. Veteran actor Akeem Alimi, popularly called Ajala Jalingo, is the new national president.
body: Nollywood actor Bolaji Amusan, popularly known as Mr Latin, has handed over leadership of the Theatre Arts and Motion Pictures Practitioners Association of Nigeria (TAMPAN) after eight years.
## The handover

The transition took place at the association's election, award and swearing-in ceremony, where veteran actor and filmmaker Akeem Alimi, popularly called Ajala Jalingo, was unveiled as the new national president.
In a video shared on his Instagram page on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, Mr Latin was seen bowing as he passed the TAMPAN flag to his successor, formally ending his eight-year run as president.
## Background
TAMPAN is one of the main associations of Nigerian theatre and film practitioners.

stories.h: At least 30 killed as fuel tanker overturns and bursts into flames in Cairo
stories.p: At least 30 people died and 15 were injured when a fuel tanker overturned and caught fire on the Greater Cairo Ring Road in Egypt on Wednesday. The blaze engulfed 27 vehicles.
body: At least 30 people have died and 15 others were injured after a fuel tanker overturned and burst into flames on a busy stretch of the Greater Cairo Ring Road in Egypt on Wednesday, 25 November 2026.
## What happened

According to Egypt's Ministry of Health and Population, the fire broke out above Tunnel 10 in the densely populated Al-Warraq area of Imbaba, a suburb of Greater Cairo. Preliminary findings suggest the privately operated tanker swerved, hit a concrete road divider and toppled over, causing an explosion that spread to 27 nearby vehicles.
## The response

Authorities sent 39 ambulances to the scene, taking survivors to three hospitals in the area. Firefighters brought the blaze under control, and heavy machinery was brought in to clear the burnt-out vehicles.
## Condolences
Egyptian President Abdel-Fattah el-Sisi and Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly sent condolences to the families of the victims.
more: At least 30 people died and 15 were injured.

The tanker hit a road divider before overturning.

stories.h: Iyabo Ojo speaks after monarch declines her handshake at Lagos party
stories.p: Actress Iyabo Ojo has reportedly addressed a viral video in which the Olu of Orile Kemta, Oba Adetokunbo Tejuosho, did not accept her handshake at a celebrity anniversary party. She offered context and an apology.
body: Nollywood actress Iyabo Ojo has spoken out after a video of an awkward moment with a traditional ruler went viral.
## What happened

The incident took place on 22 November at the 10th wedding anniversary celebration of socialite Mummy Glee and her husband in Lagos. In the video, Iyabo Ojo walked up to a table of traditional rulers to greet them. Two of the monarchs shook her hand, but the Olu of Orile Kemta, Oba Adetokunbo Tejuosho, did not, and she moved on to greet the next person.
## Her response
On Wednesday, 25 November 2026, the actress addressed the incident on Instagram, offering context and an apology.
## How people reacted
The clip had sparked debate online before her response.
## 'I didn't know he was a king'
In her apology, Iyabo Ojo said she did not realise he was a monarch when she offered her hand.
## The monarch responds

In a phone interview, the Olu of Orile Kemta, Oba Adetokunbo Tejuosho, said he was busy on his phone at the time, and that people close to him know he does not shake hands with people who reach out to him, as a matter of personal culture and belief rather than any feeling against the actress.

stories.h: Asisat Oshoala earns master's degree in international sports management
stories.p: Super Falcons striker Asisat Oshoala has graduated with a Master of Science in International Sports Management. She shared congratulatory messages from friends on Instagram.
body: Super Falcons striker Asisat Oshoala has added an academic milestone to her achievements after graduating with a Master of Science degree in International Sports Management from the Global Institute of Sports.

The forward shared several congratulatory messages from friends on her Instagram Stories to mark the achievement.
## Her career

Oshoala, who now plays for Al Hilal in the Saudi Women's Premier League, holds the record for the most CAF Women's Player of the Year titles, having won the award six times, in 2014, 2016, 2017, 2019, 2022 and 2023. She is one of the most decorated players in African women's football.

stories.h: Benny Hinn's jacket moment with Apostle Suleman's daughter goes viral
stories.p: A video of televangelist Benny Hinn placing his white jacket over Apostle Johnson Suleman's daughter as she fell during worship has gone viral. It happened at a conference at Omega Fire Ministries in Benin.
body: A moment from a church conference in Benin City involving televangelist Benny Hinn and the daughter of Apostle Johnson Suleman has become one of the most talked-about clips of the week.

On Tuesday, 24 November 2026, during worship at The Restoration City, the headquarters of Omega Fire Ministries International on the Benin-Okene road, Divine Johnson Suleman fell to the floor. Hinn took off his white jacket and placed it over her.
## The conference

The incident happened on the opening day of the International Amazing Grace 2026 conference, a six-day gathering running from 24 to 29 November under the theme 'Ultimate Power', hosted by Apostle Suleman.

stories.p: Singer Brymo has called on President Tinubu to rename the National Theatre in Lagos after the late Pete Edochie, while saying Wole Soyinka does not deserve the honour. His remarks have sparked heated debate.
body: Singer Brymo has sparked a heated online debate after calling on President Bola Tinubu to rename the National Theatre in Lagos in honour of the late Nollywood legend Pete Edochie.

In a video posted on Instagram on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, Brymo addressed the president directly, urging him to immortalise Edochie by attaching his name to the iconic landmark.

Brymo's comments have sparked heated debate online.

In a statement on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, by the director of strategic communication for the ADC Presidential Campaign Council, Atiku's campaign cited figures from the government's own Budget Office. It said the government collected ₦7.88 trillion in oil revenue between January and June 2026, well below its half-year target of ₦18.65 trillion, leaving a shortfall of about ₦10.78 trillion.

No response from the presidency or the APC campaign was included in the reports.

Atiku, who turned 80 on Wednesday, is the ADC's candidate in the January 2027 election. President Tinubu sent him a birthday message despite their rivalry.

The Kwankwasiyya movement is led by former Kano governor Rabiu Kwankwaso, who is now the NDC's vice-presidential candidate. The allegation comes amid growing concern about political violence ahead of the 2027 elections, following deadly attacks on NDC events in Delta and Edo states this week.

stories.p: Suspected bandits reportedly abducted nine people from two houses in Millennium City, Chikun, Kaduna State, late on Tuesday, later releasing three. Six remain in captivity.
body: Suspected bandits have reportedly abducted six residents in the Millennium City area of Chikun Local Government Area, Kaduna State.

The attackers stormed two houses at around midnight on Tuesday, 24 November 2026, shooting and breaking in before taking nine people away. Residents said they began hearing gunshots at about 11:30pm.
Three of those abducted, including an elderly woman and a mother with her toddler, were later released, leaving six people in captivity.
## Residents' fears
A man whose wife is among those still held said he feared for her safety because she has difficulty walking, and appealed for help to rescue her.
## Background

Kaduna has seen several kidnapping incidents in recent weeks, including a foiled attempt at a school in Zangon Kataf and the abduction of Boys' and Girls' Brigade members in Kachia/Kajuru, most of whom troops rescued.

stories.h: NDC says supporters were attacked in Benin as Obi arrived for campaign
stories.p: The Nigeria Democratic Congress has alleged that gunmen attacked its supporters and campaign vehicles on Airport Road, Benin City, as Peter Obi arrived in Edo State on Wednesday. It said one supporter was critically wounded.
body: The Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) has alleged that its supporters were attacked in Benin City, Edo State, on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, as its presidential candidate Peter Obi arrived for a town hall meeting and other campaign events.
## What the party says

According to the party, attackers who arrived in a pickup van opened fire on its campaign vehicles parked along Airport Road while supporters waited for Obi. A party spokesperson posted videos online showing damaged vehicles and bloodstains, and said one supporter was critically wounded and receiving hospital treatment.

In a statement, the NDC's National Publicity Secretary said the attackers also assaulted people in the crowd and destroyed buses, and described the attack as unprovoked. The party blamed thugs it said were linked to the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC).
## The other side
No response from the APC or the police to the allegation was included in the reports.
## Background

The incident comes two days after gunmen attacked an NDC campaign event in Delta State, killing several people, and on the same day the House of Representatives warned that a state of emergency might be needed in Delta if violence continues. The NDC has also boycotted a security meeting called by the police chief.
## Police and governor respond

The Edo State Police Command confirmed the shooting, saying three gunmen in a pickup van opened fire after sighting police officers, and that one supporter was wounded. Governor Monday Okpebholo denied that he or the APC were involved, and claimed at a rally that the NDC staged the attack to damage his reputation. The NDC has not responded to his claim in reports.

stories.p: President Tinubu visited Maiduguri on Wednesday, where he commissioned projects, held a campaign rally and directed security agencies to step up operations against insurgents. He promised to turn security gains in the North-East into economic recovery.
